rows.blurb: Thomas secured both targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 22-17 win over the Bengals on Sunday.

rows.headline: Comes up short in wild loss to Dallas
rows.blurb: Stroud completed 21 of 31 passes for 347 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-30 loss to the Cowboys. He added 12 yards on two carries.

rows.title: Colston Loveland: Draws nine targets from Bagent
rows.headline: Draws nine targets from Bagent
rows.blurb: Loveland caught six of nine targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets.

rows.title: Tucker Kraft: Finds end zone in narrow win
rows.headline: Finds end zone in narrow win
rows.blurb: Kraft brought in six of seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 17-14 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also rushed once for three yards.

rows.title: Rashee Rice: Doubtful to return in Week 4
rows.headline: Doubtful to return in Week 4
rows.blurb: Rice (hamstring) is doubtful to return to Sunday's contest in Las Vegas.

rows.title: Luther Burden: Ties season high with 63 rec yards
rows.headline: Ties season high with 63 rec yards
rows.blurb: Burden caught four of six targets for 63 yards and added an 11-yard rush in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets.

rows.title: Rome Odunze: Season-best game with Bagent
rows.headline: Season-best game with Bagent
rows.blurb: Odunze caught six of seven targets for 94 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets.

rows.title: Nico Collins: Scores twice in return to lineup
rows.headline: Scores twice in return to lineup
rows.blurb: Collins caught seven of eight targets for 118 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-30 loss to the Cowboys.

rows.title: Trevor Lawrence: Efficient, mistake-free in win
rows.headline: Efficient, mistake-free in win
rows.blurb: Lawrence completed 18 of 23 passes for 227 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions while adding three carries for no gain in the Jaguars' 22-17 win over the Bengals on Sunday.

rows.title: Christian Watson: Paces team in receiving yards
rows.headline: Paces team in receiving yards
rows.blurb: Watson secured all three targets for 47 yards in the Packers' 17-14 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

rows.headline: Three-TD day in Week 4 win
rows.blurb: Maye completed 22 of 37 passes for 269 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 54 yards in the Patriots' 29-26 win over the Bills on Sunday. He threw a two-point conversion pass and committed three fumbles, losing one and recovering the other two.

rows.title: Geno Smith: Just eight completions in loss
rows.headline: Just eight completions in loss
rows.blurb: Smith completed eight of 15 pass attempts for 119 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-12 loss to the Bears.

rows.title: Kenyon Sadiq: Held catchless by Bears
rows.headline: Held catchless by Bears

rows.title: Braelon Allen: Monopolizes carries in Hall's absence
rows.headline: Monopolizes carries in Hall's absence
rows.blurb: Allen rushed 14 times for 59 yards and caught both of his targets for eight yards in Sunday's 23-12 loss to the Bears.

rows.title: Garrett Wilson: Struggles along with entire offense Week 4
rows.headline: Struggles along with entire offense Week 4
rows.blurb: Wilson caught three of four targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 23-12 loss to the Bears.

rows.title: Josh Allen: Two total TDs in loss
rows.headline: Two total TDs in loss
rows.blurb: Allen completed 23 of 33 passes for 253 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added five carries for four yards and another score in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

rows.title: Dak Prescott: Rides Lamb to comeback win
rows.headline: Rides Lamb to comeback win
rows.blurb: Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans. He added seven yards on two carries.

rows.title: James Cook: Highly efficient with 12 carries
rows.headline: Highly efficient with 12 carries
rows.blurb: Cook rushed 12 times for 75 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for eight yards in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

rows.title: Chase Brown: Massive production as receiver
rows.headline: Massive production as receiver
rows.blurb: Brown rushed nine times for 10 yards and brought in all 11 targets for 71 yards in the Bengals' 22-17 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

rows.title: George Pickens: Two long gains in win over Houston
rows.headline: Two long gains in win over Houston
rows.blurb: Pickens caught two of three targets for 75 yards in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: Tyson Bagent: No TDs in Week 4 win
rows.headline: No TDs in Week 4 win
rows.blurb: Bagent completed 25 of 34 passes for 268 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He also rushed four times for one yard.

rows.title: Javonte Williams: Makes three trips to end zone in Week 4 win
rows.headline: Makes three trips to end zone in Week 4 win
rows.blurb: Williams carried the ball 19 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: CeeDee Lamb: Historic day in comeback win
rows.headline: Historic day in comeback win
rows.blurb: Lamb caught 17 of 21 targets for 189 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: Jalen Hurts: Modest numbers without top targets
rows.headline: Modest numbers without top targets

rows.title: Matthew Stafford: Overcomes two INTs in comeback win
rows.headline: Overcomes two INTs in comeback win
rows.blurb: Stafford completed 32 of 51 passes for 317 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles. He also rushed three times for 10 yards.

rows.title: Davante Adams: Quiet in Nacua's return

rows.headline: Stellar numbers in Week 4 loss

rows.title: Rashee Rice: Departs Sunday's contest
rows.headline: Departs Sunday's contest

rows.title: Bucky Irving: Modest production with 16 carries

rows.blurb: Irving rushed 16 times for 61 yards in the Buccaneers' 17-14 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

rows.title: D'Andre Swift: Outplayed by Monangai in Week 4
rows.headline: Outplayed by Monangai in Week 4
rows.blurb: Swift rushed 15 times for 58 yards and caught both of his targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He also lost a fumble.

rows.title: Stefon Diggs: Team-high five grabs in Week 4 loss

rows.headline: Suiting up in Week 4
